strings.title: Cloud Core Business Insights
strings.intro: Business plans, primary material and research records supporting ongoing inference-compression research.
strings.boundary: Imported plans await review. Workflows, metrics and experiments are design proposals; original material remains in Chinese.
strings.ready: Material loaded; each record indicates its source-review status.
strings.failed: Data could not be loaded or its revision changed. Please refresh.
strings.flywheel_intro: Explore each stage's work, outputs and feedback.
strings.library_intro: Research methods, business plans, study proposals and tracking notes. Select an item to read the original.
strings.sources_intro: Public material is stored as original links and attribution. Unverified links are marked; full papers and news articles are not stored in this library.
strings.proposed_boundary: These proposals combine source material and supplementary design. Targets and measurement methods still require business review.
strings.privacy_boundary: Notes with sensitive indicators were quarantined as whole files. Configuration, chat logs, tools and media were excluded. Indicators can be false positives and need local review; excluded content and paths are not displayed.
strings.refresh_policy: Source reviews record versions and dates while preserving earlier evidence. Suggested workflow frequencies have not been configured as automatic collection jobs.
strings.no_measurements: No measured results or formal decisions are recorded. Example values in the original proposal are not treated as measurements.
strings.measurements_available: Measurement records exist; inspect their experiment and review status.
strings.source_language: Original source language: Chinese. Source wording and plan boundaries are retained.
strings.bounded_provenance: Showing the first 20 source references; further links are retained in the library.
strings.archive_summary: Browse earlier business plans, imported material and curation records. Statistics, experiments and conclusions retain their review status.
